'''''Plectranthus ciliatus''''', called '''Indian borage''', '''speckled spur flower''', '''blue spur flower''' (a name shared with other members of its genus), and '''candlestick plant''' (shared with many other species), is a species of flowering plant in the family [[Lamiaceae]].<ref>{{cite web |title=''Plectranthus ciliatus'' Indian borage |url=https://www.rhs.org.uk/Plants/13250/Plectranthus-ciliatus/Details |publisher=The Royal Horticultural Society |access-date=5 April 2021 }}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=https://davesgarden.com/guides/pf/go/59586 |title=''Plectranthus ciliatus'' |author=<!--Not stated--> |date=2021 |website=Dave's Garden |publisher=MH Sub I, LLC dba Internet Brands. |access-date=5 April 2021 }}</ref> It is native to [[South Africa]] and [[Eswatini]], and introduced to [[Victoria (Australia)|Victoria]] in [[Australia]] and the [[North Island|North]] and [[South Island|South Islands]] of [[New Zealand]].<ref name="454314-1" >{{cite web |url=http://powo.science.kew.org/taxon/urn:lsid:ipni.org:names:454314-1 |title=''Plectranthus ciliatus'' E.Mey. |author=<!--Not stated--> |website=Plants of the World Online |publisher=Board of Trustees of the Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew |access-date=5 April 2021 }}</ref> With its ''[[Coleus]]''{{nbh}}like foliage, its cultivar 'Easy Gold' has gained the [[Royal Horticultural Society]]'s [[Award of Garden Merit]] as an ornamental.<ref>{{cite web |title=''Plectranthus ciliatus'' 'Easy Gold' (v) plectranthus 'Easy Gold' |url=https://www.rhs.org.uk/Plants/134283/Plectranthus-ciliatus-Easy-Gold-(v)/Details |publisher=The Royal Horticultural Society |access-date=5 April 2021 }}</ref>
